paper_id: Qian et al. - 2011 - Cardinality Estimation for Large-Scale RFID Systems
title: Cardinality Estimation for Large-Scale RFID Systems
venue: IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems
motivation: 移动物体上的RFID标签在传统识别协议完成前就离开阅读器范围,导致计数失效
problem_framing: 在标签数量未知且可动的大规模RFID系统中,如何在短时间内准确估计标签基数
key_insight: 碰撞不再被视为资源浪费,而是将碰撞槽排列成有序模式从中提取基数信息
method_signature: Lottery Frame (LoF): 几何分布哈希+ALOHA时隙+右端零位置估计
evaluation_criteria: 估计误差界(β)、时间槽数量、处理延迟、可扩展性(2^32上限)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 标签可能非均匀分布时需改进哈希方法;估计精度随哈希数增加而改善但有极限
evidence_for_taste: tag collisions are no longer considered as waste
collisions are no longer considered as waste of time
The penalty is only a little extra memory
If we do not know the tag cardinality
thinking_moves: 把碰撞从干扰源重新定义为信息源
将空槽计数问题转化为碰撞模式几何分布问题
借用数据库概率计数算法(Flajolet-Martin)到RFID场景
用哈希性质天然消除多读者场景的重复计数
固定帧长实现scalability,牺牲存储换时间
cites_own_work: Cardinality Estimation for Large-Scale RFID Systems (PerCom 2008)
ASAP: Scalable Identification and Counting for Contactless RFID Systems (ICDCS 2010)
